title: Catalyst Turnaround instance configuration
description: Reaches the manager as ManagerInvocation.config. These are the constants of the methodology, exposed because an investor's tolerance for a company that has to survive its own catalyst is theirs and not the author's. What is NOT configurable from here is the shape of the method: the catalyst record's required fields, the state machine, the separation of announcement from execution from results, and the refusal to read a price move as catalyst success. Nothing in this file can loosen the Mandate. Every value here is also written into PROMPT.md and into lib/constants.mjs, because an invocation may carry no config block at all, and tools/verify-catalyst-turnaround.mjs asserts the three agree.

catalystHorizonDays.description: Calendar days. A catalyst whose window neither opens nor closes within this many days of asOf is research rather than a position. 180 is two Korean quarterly reporting cycles: the hold is scoped to the catalyst window and the earnings release that can confirm it, so the horizon has to still contain a confirming report after one slip. One cycle does not.

priorYearStaleDays.description: Calendar days between a source's publication and asOf, above which it is not a current catalyst. 365 is one full annual reporting cycle: an announcement a year old has had a complete set of results to appear in, and if it has not appeared the thing to record is that absence. This is what stops a near-identical story from an earlier year being re-registered as today's.

maxDelays.description: How many times one catalyst's deadline may move before the position goes to an exit review. A first delay is information, a second is a pattern, a third is the failure mode this rule exists to stop — the same threat recorded again and again while the capital stays. With a 180-day horizon two delays already carry the hold past a full year. This is a stated policy and not a measurement.

minRunwayMonths.description: Months of cash burn the company must be funded for, computed as liquidAssets divided by monthlyCashBurn. 12 is twice the catalyst horizon: the position is survivable only if the company outlives its own catalyst with the same margin again for one delay. A company that is not funded through its catalyst is a refinancing bet wearing a turnaround's clothes.

debtCoverageFloor.description: The ratio (liquidAssets + securedRefinancing) / debtMaturingWithinYear that must be cleared. 1.0 is an accounting identity rather than a preference: below it the company needs money nobody has promised it. There is deliberately no headroom, because headroom here would be an opinion about a lender.

minImprovingChannels.description: How many DISTINCT recovery channels must be improving before a candidate is a position. One improving indicator is a point; the claim being made is a path — the leading indicator and the link to cash — and two distinct channels is the smallest number that can draw one. Distinctness is the load-bearing word: a receivable balance and the interest it stops accruing are one fact written down twice.

kellyFraction.description: The fraction of the Kelly risk budget the position sizing uses. Quarter-Kelly is the standard haircut for parameter uncertainty and is inherited rather than chosen: full Kelly assumes the probability estimate is correct, which for a catalyst date is exactly the thing that is uncertain.

defaultSingleNameCap.description: Portfolio weight. The most any one name may reach from this strategy when the Mandate declares nothing narrower. It is a ceiling and never a default order size: the target weight is the minimum of this, the Mandate's own cap, the whole-account headroom for that name, and what the distance to invalidation actually funds.

trimPriceProgress.description: Progress along (price − entry) / (target − entry) at which a realised catalyst is trimmed. 0.7 draws the line the phrase «trim once the recovery is in the price» needs: the last 30% of the path is the part earned only if the assumption was exactly right, and a methodology whose subject is whether an estimate lands should not be paid for precision it never claimed.

stabilisationWindowDays.description: Sessions of price behind the secondary confirmation that the fall has stopped. Roughly a quarter of trading. It confirms and it never qualifies: nothing in this package may turn price stabilisation, an oscillator or a valuation multiple into a universal entry condition, and the deepest fall is never preferred for being the deepest.
